name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Screenshots of Slack messages, emails and meetings capture tasks, but they pile up in camera rolls.
Important action items get buried and deadlines are missed.
Manually copying tasks from images into a task manager takes time and effort.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
SDG 8, Decent Work and Economic Growth: Recovering tasks from screenshots reduces manual entry and helps people keep work on track.
SDG 9, Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure: The project uses a connected microservice architecture across Rust, Python and C++.
SDG 12, Responsible Consumption and Production: Planned source image cleanup can reduce unnecessary digital storage.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Frontend and gateway: Rust with Axum serves the dashboard and routes API requests.
AI service: Python and FastAPI use watchdog folder monitoring and Gemini 2.0 Vision to read screenshots and extract action items.
Data service: C++ with Crow stores tasks in SQLite using WAL mode.
The interface uses JavaScript, custom dark-mode styling and automatic dashboard polling.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Drop a screenshot into a designated folder to start task extraction.
Vision AI identifies action items, priorities, due dates and assignees.
Extracted tasks appear on a live dashboard, replacing manual transcription with an automated capture-to-task flow.

name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Build native iOS and Android companion apps.
Connect with Slack, Microsoft Teams and Jira.
Sync extracted due dates with calendars.
Add automatic deletion of source screenshots to free device space.
Thank you! Stop losing tasks in your camera roll. Live demo and Q&A.
